title: The gaming site sponsored by Walmart lays off its editorial staff
summary: Restart’s former editor-in-chief says the ‘entire editorial team’ has been cut. Restart is operated by Moonrock, a content marketing agency, though its editorial mission page says it’s “powered” by Walmart.
